notes.title: Fleapit’s Grab Bag: Back to the Grab Bag
notes.content:
Heeeeeey Guests of the Fleapit~

Coming right at ya is yet another Fleapit devlog where we drag you kicking and screaming through the depths of development hell (or rather Inferno) and show all the exciting stuff (that we can show at this point in time)!

As per usual, the biggest bulk of the work we’ve been doing these last couple of months has been focused on behind-the-scenes stuff – but we’re making steady progress, pinky promise!!

That said, let’s dive into the nitty gritty, shall we?

[h3]UPKEEPING THE OLD STUFF[/h3]

Turns out working on a game breeds… even more game. Thankfully, at this point we’re more that ever aware that polishing things into perfection isn’t exactly the way to go, but making additional touches here and there won’t hurt anybody.

Like, for example, here’s a new cute little sprite for Ruby’s speech during the opening cutscene:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PGPkTjq9/image5.gif[/img]
[i]of course its Ruby breaking the 4th wall, who else?[/i]

Would you love to see more of these? Definitely let us know in the comments, y’all!

[h3]GLITCHES NO GLITCHING[/h3]

One of the more requested things from the previous demo was to remove the visual glitches during dungeon crawling. So we did exactly that…and also added an option to have even more visual glitches, should you choose to do so. 

For reference, we believe that the Full glitches option represents our vision for Fleapit’s chaotic visuals, but we don’t wanna ruin anyone’s personal experience, so feel free to turn them down!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/hJpVR0jj/image3.gif[/img]
[i]warning: the slider doesn’t actually influence any of the gameplay glitches. . .[/i]

[h3]HOT DEMON LADY WITH NO CONTEXT[/h3]

It’s that time of the year again! The Freaked Fleapit roster of characters is growing with its development and it’s always fun to just show you the concept arts with no context whatsoever.

Even though you don’t know her just yet, we know you’re gonna grow to love her… eventually~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/35e8e6ff39f2f0391cc79f71ae096d0e8b629f31.png[/img]
[i]we were this close to just stop on the bald version[/i]

[h3]WOULD YOU LIKE A FASARIA TAMAGOTCHI?[/h3]

Now, I’m not saying we’re working on one! I’m not even saying that we will ever be working on one. But [i]hypothetically[/i] is this something of interest for you?

And could I perhaps influence your answer by showing you this lil creature?
[img]https://i.ibb.co/k2vKtZvf/image2.gif[/img]

[h3]FREAKED FLEAPIT TRIVIA BIT: GOD I WISH THIS WAS ME[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e294c0d612b9ba6475771b3472d4714b0b9d5235.png[/img]
[i]ok, seriously though, that’s just a new concept art that was made in time while i was writing this very devlog. Consider it a freebie for waiting extra long lol.[/i]

Oh-kay, that’s gonna be it for today’s special!

It’s our cue to crawl back into the (development) Inferno, keep hammering away, and emerge again soon with more cursed updates. As always, thank you for coming along for the ride and see you next time.

Love y’all~

notes.title: Fleapit’s Grab Bag Returns... With Vengeance!
notes.content:
[h3]Heeeeeey Guests of the Fleapit~[/h3]

We may have skipped a month or two of these devlogs, hope that was just about enough time for you to start missing us a little bit! 

Truth be told, we had to go slower than usual this last month due to quite a few team members getting sick (including me, who writes this very text lol), but we’re very much back in action and today we’re gonna make it up to you with quite a few gameplay bits from the upcoming New And Improved Steam Demo that we’ve been talking a lot in the past.

So let’s get the show rolling, shall we?

[h3]New Traps, New Foes[/h3]

For starters, we can finally show more enemies that will torture your existence in the upcoming updated demo!

As you might recall, we promised to extend each Circle of Hell with subfloors – with each one containing a few exclusive demons that get progressively harder the deeper you go! This time around we’re going to focus on Limbo exclusively, so stay tuned for the next episode to see more, ok?~

[b]MIMIC[/b]

Ah, the FromSoft classic! Some of the props around Limbo contain pesky Mimics which will emerge as soon as you approach them, so keep an eye out for this pair of eyes and maybe tone down the aggression towards the surrounding furniture, just in case.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oQ2OZ5u.gif[/img]

[b]COFFEE MANIAC[/b]

Surely this much coffee can’t be good for you? Well, Coffee Maniac seems to disagree – as long as a coffee machine is nearby, he’s literally unkillable. Without his fuel, however, he’s quite vulnerable, so you better dart across the room and de-coffee-fy it before finishing the poor sod off!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lKbXDMa.gif[/img]

[b]BOOKKEEPER[/b]

Watch your steps cuz it’s raining books! These nerdy demons prefer to take cover in the most annoying parts of any given room and support the main cast of enemies with projectiles that will keep you on the move. Imagine being sandwiched in a room between a bookkeeper and a coffee maniac and you’re in for a fun time~

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hdiyfjm.gif[/img]

Of course, there’s even more demons we didn’t mention so far – but you’ll have to see them for yourselves. It wouldn’t be fun to spoil everything after all, right?

[h3]More Items = More Fun[/h3]

One of the things that was highly requested after the first demo were more impactful items. Ask and you shall receive, dear Guests of the Fleapit!

First of all, the random pick ups are categorized as ‘items’ and ‘skills’: the former ones being one-time use and latter recharging after a certain number of rooms is successfully cleared.

Let’s go over a couple of examples together, shall we?

[b]GARLIC BREATH[/b]

A one-time use item that is all about dealing AoE damage in a massive radius. Just find a few suitable targets and deploy the stench that makes even the toughest demons suffer! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CNRxG35.gif[/img]

[b]PURE SIN[/b]

This one’s trickier to use, but the potential for carnage is endless! Once you use a bottle of Pure Sin, you will have poisonous puddles appear underneath Newbie for a few beats and if you can predict where the enemies will be or if a lot of them are chasing you, this is a perfect recipe for quickly thinning the enemy ranks!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1GDfLbr.gif[/img]


[h3]Special Quests[/h3]

You didn’t think your visits to Circles of Hell are some kind of one and done thing, did you? Throughout your journey, Ladies of Fleapit will have requests for you – sometimes in the lobby, other times right in the dungeon.

Complete them and get the ultimate reward – the affection of a demon girl!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MrJxu8O.gif[/img]


[h3]WARNING: A new never-before-shown art from Mr. Psina is approaching fast:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/5fa15c9d54fb284e22c6b3b28703a2e61a95bba9.png[/img]

[i]I don’t have anything else to add, really, lol![/i]

[i][h3]Quick Fleapit Trivia Bit: Diffusion Crystals[/h3]

One of the most important and incredibly scarce resources of Inferno as it allows the Freaked Fleapit to be in a stable state and not descend into complete chaos. Also used by the Lords of Hell to stabilize their offices. The production of the crystals is kept a closely guarded secret so that they will always be valuable.[/i]

And that’s where we’ll hit the brakes and stop today’s devlog! We still have much to show, but we don’t want to give away everything just yet, so make sure to come by next month to see what else we got for ya!

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: Fleapit's Hell Guide: Gluttony
notes.content:
[h3]Hey kiddo, [/h3]

Been a while since I’ve taken you on a tour across the Inferno’s Circles of Hell. You might have even forgotten what we’ve been through so far, so check back the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1840880/view/3702564318224419100]Limbo[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1840880/view/6891120639582841232]Lust[/url] entries if you’ve missed the memo on how we do things here.

Are we back to speed now? Good, cuz we got no time to waste, it’s time to step into the Circle of:

[h2]G L U T T O N Y[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/3b866464f513fb44db496b4892f7a28e2a71b5c9.png[/img]
[i]Just some of the potential little chefs you’re about to meet at the Circle of Gluttony[/i]

Ah yes, kiddo, this ain’t no “hole in the wall” restaurant nor a cheap noodle place you liked so much in your life. This is high cuisine, an establishment that screams “spectacular opulence” in your flustered face as you come in.

Ever been in those restaurants that you feel like you don’t even deserve to be in? Well, you are in one now and the sheer feeling of grandioseness is almost impenetrable. The greatest restaurant in all Inferno, or hell, even the whole wide world.

[i]The Circle Of Gluttony.[/i]

So what are we waiting for? Sit down, grab a menu and call a waiter cuz…

Wait, you didn’t really think that you would be getting a chance to feast in such a luxurious place for the rest of eternity, did you? Oh, I see. Excuse me for a moment.

[b]AHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHHAHA[/b]

Hell no, kiddo, if you are a sinner, you aren’t getting a fancy seat at the classy table. [b]You’re the one getting served.[/b]

Metaphorically, of course. You see, hunger turned out to be a pretty potent source of Sin, especially in more, ahem, greedier residents of Gluttony. So the only source of food you’ll ever get is the disgusting poisonous juice that will only make you hungrier in perpetuity.

Bottoms up, maybe this next drink will make the ever growing emptiness go away.

You might be wondering, if all this luxury is kind of unnecessary and the cake is a lie, just *who* is this place for? The only one who gets to bask in the glory of this own creation is the master of this Circle of Hell, the most vain and gluttonous demon of them all…

[h3]THE SOMMELIER[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/13e21a1370204924f6354553b737efa23cca9486.png[/img]

In parallel universes he might as well could have been the Master of [b]Circles of Pride[/b] or [b]Greed[/b], or maybe even [b]Wrath[/b] – but the sheer excess of everything he does and lives for made him a perfect vessel for leading the Circle of [b]Gluttony[/b].

Underneath his pretty face lies a sadistic and hysterical monster that can never be truly satiated. Or rather, two monsters – one demon and one especially nasty parasite which co-exist in an extremely perverted mutually symbiotic relationship. 

Throughout the eternity of leading the Circle of Gluttony, there’s only one thing that The Sommelier hasn’t gotten a taste of – a pure soul. Because, you know, those don’t ever get to Inferno.

So you better brace yourself, kiddo. There’s not a lot of things this bastard won’t do to get his hands on the best meal of his lifetime.

But thankfully we don’t have to face him just yet, so let’s wrap this up before the waiters arrive and move somewhere safe. We’ll continue next time at the Circle of Greed, so make sure to save some money till then, okay?

Thank you so much for kickin' it with us this year! Happy Holidays and we'll see you back in 2025 with more Fleapit goodness <3

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

notes.title: Meet the Girls: Sister June BIO
notes.content:
Hi, guests of the Fleapit!~

We’ve been talking about the Ladies of the Fleapit quite a lot and we saved the best for last! ‘Best’ being of course the story of everyone’s favorite mommy, Sister June. So polish your halos, spread your wings and let’s dive straight into it, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/bf6f3d9807a58e05d6711559e9b3fd1a7081eb9c.png[/img]
[h3]Quick facts:[/h3]
[b]EN VA: [/b]Melissa Medina
[b]JP VA: [/b]Sayaka Ohara
[b]Age: [/b]~2400 years old
[b]Height: [/b]200 cm (6' 6.7")
[b]Nicknames:[/b] Juney, The Big Lady, Mommy. Noble Sister June Warrior of Fire and Light, Senior Secretary to the Head of the Ancient Knowledge and Competence Department.
[b]Favorite movies:[/b] Romance movies, biographies and movies with cute animals.
[b]Hobbies:[/b] Keeping order and balance among all of the Inferno’s chaos. Also secretly playing visual novels on Fasaria’s Dethboy.
[b]Favorite drink:[/b] Hot coffee with whipped cream.

[i]‘Did you fall from Heaven?’[/i] isn’t really a pick-up line for Sister June, because she really is an actual angel. And a real outlier in the whole demonic cast of Freaked Fleapit characters. I mean, aren’t angels and demons supposed to hate each other's guts and have a Great War between them?

Well, a long, long time ago they did. And the fearsome Noble Sister June, Warrior of Fire and Light, the commander of the Hand of Justice Squad was a name to be reckoned with. She may seem almost too gentle and harmless nowadays, but back then if you were a demon and you crossed her path  — I’m afraid you wouldn’t get much mercy from her.

That same righteous fury became her downfall.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/a78c1e1b341acc44208ff7ad49e74765d0bcf328.png[/img]
[i]Noble Sister June, Warrior of Fire and Light in full armor from the olden times[/i]

During one of the operations, Noble Sister June’s squad encountered The Angel Slayer — a monster who annihilated countless of their brothers and sisters. Lucifer's mightiest warrior. And he’s all alone here, a perfect opportunity to strike while he’s vulnerable.

The higher command ordered them to retreat immediately. June didn’t listen. Today was the day The Angel Slayer is gonna fall, and Justice will prevail. Maybe this was the opportunity to end this war once and for all and Sister June didn’t come this far just to run away. And so they began the attack…

…all according to the Angel Slayer’s plan.

The Hand of Justice Squad was no more. Except for the disgraced commander, Noble Sister June, Warrior of Fire and Light. She put up one hell of a fight, a duel that could end up in legends if there was anyone else alive left to tell. A final battle of Heaven and Inferno.

But alas, we shall never know who would’ve won in that fight. The Great War between Heaven and Inferno was over right in the middle of that fateful duel. The decisive battle was all for naught. 

If only June obeyed the orders, so many angels would’ve lived another day. And the higher command made sure to make her remember that [b]forever.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/cf931dd9a51d6e973e06e7cfc39034d11d107b75.png[/img]
[i]You don’t wanna know how June got this handprint on her back[/i]

[i]“But wait”,[/i] you may ask, [i]“That doesn’t explain how Sister June ended up in Freaked Fleapit with her sworn enemies!”[/i] And that, dear guests of Fleapit, is reaching the spoilers territory of biblical proportions, so we’ll have to wrap up right here in fear of telling you too much.

We hope you enjoyed a glimpse into Sister June’s past and appreciate her on a whole nother level — as both a motherly figure and a mighty warrior!

Thank you for stopping by, and see you in the next Fleapit Direct (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: http://patreon.com/FinchBird) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the real Inferno that is Twitter and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

notes.content:
[h3]Hiya, guests of the Fleapit!~[/h3]

And welcome back to yet another edition of Fleapit HQ Direct where we show some of the cool stuff we’ve been working on behind the scenes! Strap in and come along for the ride, cuz there’s quite a bit to go through this time.

Y’all ready? Then let’s begin!

[h2]EXPANDING THE INFERNO[/h2]

One of the most often requested feedback we received from our demo was ‘please make longer levels’. And while we’ve already committed to make every Circle of Hell longer with three increasingly difficult levels, we want to make each one of them feel somewhat unique.

Thus, we’re working on creating special tiles for each zone that would feel more thematically appropriate and help us convey the storyline of each Circle of Hell!

Like, check out one of the deeper rooms of Limbo below (with a brand new enemy teaser haha)

notes.title: Freaked Fleapit Dev HQ Direct — June ‘24
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, guests of the Fleapit![/h3]

What a month, huh? We’re incredibly excited to share a sneak peek behind the gates of Fleapit, and seeing your genuine excitement and passion for our game filled us with even more determination to make the best rhythm--slash-dungeon crawler-slash-date sim ever!

That being said, there’s no time to waste basking in the afterglow for us. There’s still much to do based on both our original development plans and your demo feedback, so let’s get right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e2e6e75aa0a432d00602cec670afd9f5966135ea.gif[/img]

[h3]WHAT’S NEXT FOR THE DEMO[/h3]

Honestly, not much. We’ve worked up some quick bug fixes and we just added the Russian VO, but we’re now focusing on the Next Big Thing and, truthfully, we just don’t have the resources to also keep polishing this little demo further and further. 

We want to take a moment to restate how invaluable , and precious your feedback has been, and how incredibly thankful we are. We’re also extra excited to share that all that feedback will be implemented in…

[h3]ANOTHER NEW FLEAPIT DEMO..?![/h3]

Yep, you heard it right! I

And here’s what we’ve got in store for this next demo so far:

[list]
[*] [b]Meta-progression[/b] — more fleshed out roguelite elements, traders, perks, skills, meta-currency, and all that jazz 
[*] [b]5 dates[/b] with branching dialogue set in different locations 
[*] [b]The complete first 2 circles of Hell[/b] but this time bolder, bigger and more fun! 
[*] [b]Various mini-games[/b] including mixology, bowling, and more
[/list]

[h3][b]But that’s not all! [/b][/h3]

Thanks to all the amazing feedback we got from this first demo, we’ll be able to add some of your suggestions in as well to hopefully make this a somewhat complete experience that we’ll proceed with moving forward!

[i](pssst, this is also the part where we remind you that if you have any feedback you’d like to share with us, you can do it via [url=https://forms.gle/4QPubQy6hzjQiZcHA]this handy google form[/url] and we’ll take it into consideration, thanks in advance! <3)[/i]

We can’t promise a hard date for this next big demo thingy yet, but we are working like Hell and are hopeful it won’t take nearly as long as this last one!

And now, since we mentioned more fleshed out roguelite elements, allow us to introduce…

[h3]THE SHOPKEEPER[/h3]

It wouldn’t really be a roguelite if you can’t buy any items from a suspicious-looking merchant deep in a dungeon somewhere, would it? And since this is one of the latest characters we designed for Fleapit, we decided to share how he came to life from earlier concepts to the complete sprites.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/6cf6240aa05df80005a867f77b049e2d0a50267c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/fe8c8e37926151f326437a146c2b437575b5c7ff.png[/img]
[i]The many, many iterations of the future Shopkeeper we had a first[/i]

It all begins with an idea. We decided that our Shopkeeper should be a powerful, intimidating, and mostly stationary figure early on, but it took a lot of fine tuning with details to settle on like ‘should this even be a living creature’ or ‘what the insides of his coat should look like’. 

And after a lot of consideration and heated debates (which included pointing at the Fleapit lore document quite a bit) we landed on this guy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/0c7fc25dbb421950180d183585789a168c6815b8.gif[/img]
[i]What are ya buyin’?[/i]

Okay, so now we have a dialogue sprite for the Shopkeeper, but the work doesn’t end here. In fact, now we’re getting to the interesting part — how do we make this fellow look good in pixel art? 

A lot of you were curious about our pixel art process, so we’ll let you on a little secret: the concept art for chibi-pixel versions of characters is also being done by our lead artist Mr. Psina. And here’s what the Shopkeeper looked like - chibified:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/60199ef20f97dc4ffb19ebe8d7a83329239411ee.png[/img]

Once we settled on this design, our beloved pixel artist Todo takes over, works his own personal magic, it all comes together! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/353850985ac5e9c3538d5bd3516b4ece7faf91cf.gif[/img]
[i]Bear witness for the Shopkeeper has come to life at last![/i]


We can’t wait for you to meet him in person! Trust us, he’s a lovely individual, even if he’s stingy as all hell. Anyways, moving on!

[h3]PERK ARTS POGCHAMP PERK ARTS[/h3]

In today’s edition of ‘Perks teasers’ we have a couple of those that we internally affectionately call [i]‘Andy gets absolutely decimated’[/i] and both of these, as you’ve probably guessed, have something to do with Newbie losing HP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/acfdb0dbf831d6a36c49f5ec0e817e2753e05451.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e8db143cbf10a446b1a3db66fb91f0ee4f3b5078.jpg[/img]

While we don’t intend a ‘get hurt a lot’ playstyle to be viable, these might be helpful for those players who are new to the rhythm dungeon crawling and have occasional troubles with getting down the specific patterns and stuff. And you’ll see these, you guessed it, in the Next Steam Demo.

[h3]FLEAPIT’S QUICK TRIVIA BIT: REAPERS[/h3]

[i]Reapers reap (duh) and transport the shells of souls between the four worlds:
World of the Living -> Inferno -> Heaven -> Ministry of Death. 

All Reapers were once people who indirectly worked with death: undertakers, pathologists, death priests, etc. Wonder what made Fasaria become one.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/f1a9b26fe6bf528327fd34f78b99a1f662c729a4.png[/img]

And that brings us to the end of our devlog! Thank you for stopping by, and see you in the next Fleapit Direct (as always, available one week earlier for our Patreon supporters, hit us up on Patreon to learn more: http://patreon.com/FinchBird) 

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on the Former Bird Site and join the Freaked Fleapit Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

See ya next month~

Finch Bird Team over and out!

notes.title: Meet the Girls: Bellboy BIO
notes.content:
Hey, guests of the Fleapit!

Glad to have you with us again - not that you can really leave or anything [b]but[/b]! As promised, we’re gonna talk about our resident best girl bartender — Bellboy! So grab a drink, snag a seat, and enjoy the show~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/65174dc1a3f5997b62ab2fe7e5f10388badd5204.png[/img]

[h2]Quick facts:[/h2]
[b]EN VA: [/b]TBA 👀
[b]JP VA: [/b]Ami Koshimizu
[b]Age: [/b]21 (at the time of death)
[b]Height: [/b]174 cm (5′ 8)
[b]Nicknames:[/b] Bell, Ginger, Kid
[b]Favorite movies:[/b] Buster Keaton, Charlie Chaplin, noir, and road trip movies. Secretly might have a thing for doramas as well.
[b]Hobbies:[/b] Everything high-stakes and extreme; mixing drinks[strike] and saving lives[/strike]
[b]Favorite drink:[/b] Poitín

One might say Bellboy is one of the more [i]‘normal’[/i] regulars in the Fleapit, and that’s not [i]exactly[/i] untrue. See, she isn’t a child of [b]Inferno[/b], but rather a run-of-the-mill human born in Dublin, Ireland. 

You might be wondering, what brought her to the Fleapit, not to mention made her the bartender of the joint. Well that story goes a little something like this:

Young Bellboy had to learn to stand on her own pretty quickly. Having to run away with her family from her home country to the States only to lose her parents afterward… The world was unkind to the poor girl indeed. This kind of experience could be soul crushing to pretty much anyone, but little Bell wasn’t raised to be weak.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/83e102bf8945bcb40a09519ece281a21fc4a2806.png[/img]
[i]A *somewhat* accurate representation of Bellboy during those days[/i]

Day after day, she did all she could to keep on going, no kind of job was off-limits. By the way, have we mentioned that she was born in the early 1900s yet? Oh yes, the poor soul ended up right in the middle of the Roaring 20’s… and the Nationwide Prohibition. The whims of fate swept Bell deep into the underground world of bootlegging and, quite unfortunately, to her inevitable demise.

That should have been the end of her, but while adrift in the sea of souls, she found a guide — a sentient mantis who bound himself with Bell and helped her escape certain doom. 

Thus a new friendship was born, and Bellboy’s second, slightly more cheerful life began. These two ended up at the gates of Fleapit, and its owner took them in. When it comes to selecting staff, that sly fox always has a hunch for incredible talent, so Bell became the bartender at his theater. Or perhaps, even the best bartender in all of Inferno. 

Bellboy is truly special. Many rightfully believe that she’s the soul of the Fleapit. She’ll always be there for you when you need to drink your problems away, but maybe she could use someone who’d do that for her too?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/557def85dc00254c83992efead75533afdd5ab6e.png[/img]

*insert sad violin refrain*

[i]Aaaaaaaaaaaand cut![/i]

How’d you like the show, guests of the Fleapit? Did you expect our fiery bartender to have such a turbulent past? Let us know in the comments what you guys think, and we’ll see you next month in our regularly scheduled devlog ([i]available one week early on Patreon, yadda-yadda[/i]).

Byyyyye <3

notes.content:
Hey, guests of the Fleapit!

Another month passed by, another devlog has arrived! Looks like you enjoyed our grab bag format, so we’re running another one of these again. 

And now let's get straight to the show: 

[h2]WE MADE AUDIO CALIBRATION (and the rest of the options menu)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/50b7414f1a7d84c1fc8766cdc98e88b95b6425b9.png[/img]
[i]Design and settings are not final and subject to change![/i]

As a part of our preparations for the public demo launch (coming soon, promise!!), we finally made an actual Options menu and audio calibration! This is a more important update than it sounds because previously we were kind of operating on the basis of “let’s make the game first and all the inconsequential stuff later”.

Well, it turns out having an options menu and audio calibration for users is pretty darn important, so we’re happy finally getting that out of the way. There’s still a lot of work to be done, but we consider this another little milestone towards the full game.

[h2]DISCOVERING DIALOGUE ANIMATIONS[/h2]

[list] [img]https://i.imgur.com/pdPClQJ.gif[/img][/list]

You might’ve seen us posting a fourth-wall-breaking animation of Ruby’s dialogue on Twitter this month! Actually, we never really intended for them to be a part of the game and it’s something we just had fun with… 

…but seeing how many of you loved it on Twitter, we’re seriously considering putting them in the game for some extra special moments. Anyway, we’ve got one more for you right here so please enjoy!

[h2]DEVELOPMENT INSIGHTS: BUGS AND CREATIVITY[/h2]

Here’s a cute little thing we encountered during testing: Andy’s sprite turned into a sprite of another enemy by accident. Well, our first thought was this was annoying as Hell because we thought the build was pretty solid. But then we realized that this could become a mechanic, or an option for customization, or maybe even something else entirely!-

…orrr maybe not end up in the final game at all 🗿

Sometimes that’s just how things evolve throughout game development, new ideas are born not through sheer calculations and extensive planning, but rather through a random bug that popped up during playtesting sessions with the team!

notes.title: Happy (Freaked) Holidays!
notes.content:
[h2]It’s the most wonderful time of the year, Guests of the Fleapit![/h2]

We at Finch Bird team are wrapping up 2023, so it’s as good a time as any to reflect on what we achieved so far, what we’re doing right now, and what our plans are for the nearest future!

[h3](Almost) Done: Freaked Fleapit Demo(!?!)[/h3]

This year, we put out an exclusive live event demo that showcases what Freaked Fleapit will look like going forward — battle system, dating, quests, and even voice-over!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/1e53c5b0c866254bee3595953125cab77acf9924.png[/img]
[i]Concept arts of some of the enemies encountered in the demo[/i]

We’re incredibly thankful to everyone who gave us feedback throughout the year and proud to have players who even visited us multiple times during the events just to spend a bit more time with Freaked Fleapit!

Now, to a more pressing question: when do *you* guys get to play the demo? A quick answer is: [b]early next year[/b]. 

A more nuanced answer is: We made this current demo to see if our vertical slice even worked on players, and we realized that we can still tinker with some stuff and make the first public build of Fleapit the best it can be!

Of course, we know that some of you can’t wait to play it ‘as is’, so we’re probably going to make that build available earlier — we just need to localize and test it properly, so as many Guests of Fleapit as possible have a pleasant time.


[i](and yep, our Patreon subs will get an even earlier access, learn more about it [url=http://patreon.com/FinchBird]here[/url])[/i]

[h3]In Progress: Mini-Games![/h3]

Some eagle-eyed players on expos have already noticed that we’re planning on making a cocktail mini-game in Freaked Fleapit, but what if we told you that we have even more of these in the works? We wanted to spice up the Dating and Dungeon Crawling parts of Freaked Fleapit, so you’ll also be able to have fun with some Demonic mini-games, such as Tower Defence, Bowling, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/fba6b2e4e4cf551c0852f6538370b4f93b1966e9.png[/img]
[i]Tower Defence gameplay screen (WIP)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/254c48567afd157032843d7b2c280135680c740b.png[/img]
[i]Fasaria Bowling Cutscene[/i]

We have even more stuff in the works for both demo and full game, of course, but we’ll have to leave them outside of this devlog so as not to spoil the surprise! Perhaps, you’ll be able to find some hints, though… 🤫

Whether you play these mini-games by yourself or you take one of the Fleapit Ladies with you to gain their affection, we hope you’ll have fun!

[h3]In Progress: Lobby Upgrade[/h3]

We only showed you the initial version of Fleapit’s Lobby thus far, but we’re working on expanding the places in the shadows! 

Will our beloved Freaked Fleapit turn into a whole Freaked Amusement Center by the end of the game? Honestly, we don’t know yet, but it’s fun to play around with the idea. Anyway, here’s a tiny snippet of what’s to come, hope you enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/a57d57a294cdfe975964558d0b6a66d022207360.png[/img]

[h3]In progress: Pizza Tower[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/7b6da6beb6155ac16da0f51e37b52bf66ddb1257.png[/img]

Just kidding! I found this in our folder while searching for concept arts I can show in the devlog and, why not. We’re open to crossovers though!!

[h3]In progress: A Lot Of Other Stuff[/h3]

There’s also a lot of internal stuff we’re working on that doesn’t have cute concept arts attached yet! We’re designing new attack patterns, perks, skills, and mechanics, designing and improving narrative bits and bobs, fine-tuning the rhythm dungeon crawling, and so on.

We’ll talk about all of this more in 2024, but for now, it’s just a reminder that all of this is *also* being worked on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/15440d00617b5d04cbbb529324a55477ef2f12d6.png[/img]
[i]*Enters the devlog, drops a concept art of previously unseen character with no context*[/i]

And that’s a wrap!

Before we go, we’d like to take a moment to thank everyone who’s been following us throughout this time. It’s the best gift we could possibly ask for this holiday season, and we want you guys to know that you’ll always be our beloved Guests of the Fleapit!

We can’t wait to tell you about the many plans we have for the future that will make Freaked Fleapit even more ambitious and awesome in 2024, and we hope you’ll love what we’ve got in store as we open up the gates of the Fleapit to its first guests supersoon! 

Happy Holidays, everyone, and here’s to an even Freakier New Year! 

From Finch Bird with 💗

notes.title: Fleapit's Mini-Guide to Hell: What is Freaked Fleapit?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/2028f5da71a282a0600448b5aea41a124e8ccbc4.gif[/img]

[h3]Hey newbie,[/h3]

I bet you’re pretty curious about the place you ended up at in the first place. And to tell you the truth, so am I, for it’s a pretty weird place even by the Inferno standards.

See, the Freaked Fleapit hasn’t always been[i] a fleapit[/i]. Once upon a time, this grand Theater was an integral part of Hell's entire infrastructure, it served to teach demons and imps alike the most efficient methods to extract high quality sin from the souls of sinners.

And I have to admit, the Lord of Hell that conceived this place, that old rascal, has cracked the code —  familiarizing demons with the world of people, their culture and everyday life, to stealthily penetrate the earth and provoke them to do sinful deeds has never been easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/99f5fae3101d8d2645778d1622afed65e51cef45.png[/img]

If I told you that underneath the ruthless facade, this Lord was hiding such a sentimental side, you’d probably have a hard time believing he’s a real demon lord. He didn’t have to personally give lectures on human culture and movies in his spare time, but he did. He didn’t have to warm up to his crew, but he did!

He didn’t have to keep this place alive after it was shut down by the higher-ups… But he did.

Ah! And now we’re back in the present time – The Demon Education Program has moved forward, but the Freaked Fleapit still stands. Right now, it’s just a place where Demons, Angels and Reapers can coexist in peace. A bit rusty, a bit worn down, but not without its own charms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/f944ffad47fcf4c5a171f07a2b464b014a23da40.png[/img]
[i]Do I need to mention that all the film from the past is still there?[/i]

In my opinion there’s no better place in all Inferno, as long as you can tolerate the antics of the Fleapit’s inhabitants, that is. 👀

Theeeeeee eeeeeeeeend. [i]Or is it?[/i]

Doesn’t matter, any more info and we’ll be sent to the Circle of Spoilers instead, and trust me, kiddo, you don’t want to end up there. So we’ll wrap our little tour right here.

Next time, let's meet at the entrance of the Circle of Gluttony! Get your best dress on, kid, it’s going to be the feast of a lifetime!

notes.title: Fleapit's Hell Guide: Lust
notes.content:
Hey kiddo, 

Looks like you made it through Limbo. That’s good, it means you’ve got some fight in you! But since this [i]is[/i] hell, that's the last bit of good news that we’ve got for you today. If you want to escape the Netherworld so badly & get back to your boring maidenless life, we still have a looong road ahead of us. 

So without further delay, today we’re storming the next Circle of Hell. 

Welcome to the Circle of:

[h2]LUST[/h2]

The final stop for all you pervs and deviants out there, no need to hold back your desires darling, let that freak flag fly! This probably seems a bit at odds with what Hell is supposed to look like after the whole [i]‘eternity of nothingness’[/i] thing we had going there for a while there. As the sighs of boredom and annoyance in Limbo give way to moans and whimpers, one can’t help but think:

But isn’t hell supposed to be all [i]”pain and suffering”[/i] this, and [i]“eternal torment”[/i] that? So far this new circle sounds like a place any self-respecting (or [i]dis[/i]respecting, we don’t kink shame here) sinner would [b]actively want to end up in[/b], right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/0efd97599949aa6da0cfcff348ff1613899f1b0a.png[/img]
[i]You got a new Concept Art: Entrance to the Circle of Lust[/i]

But as you wander through the sticky, sweaty halls you might start to notice something weird. Try as hard as you might, but you can’t interact with anything, like…at all! 

It's a feast for the eyes - and the eyes only - the lewdest level of Hell leaves you wanting in every sense of the word with no release in sight. After all, demons and succubi don’t feast on your bodily fluids, it’s your misery they desire. 

So here’s your dramatic irony, kiddo. Deviants and pervs get locked up at Blue Balls Incorporated™ for an eternity and then some. But you’re built different, aren’t you? And given how you beat Chunky, you might even stand a chance of getting through another Overlord…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/db367d24bfefb1f35da66ac2c84911f08078a949.png[/img]
[h2]SALLY [/h2]
🐙[b]The Queen of Tentacles herself[/b]🐙

Sally has rightfully earned her place as the most lascivious demon in Hell and the undisputed leader of the Circle of Lust. She’s got eyes everywhere in her domain, and that’s not a figure of speech. Her private room is actually an exquisitely voyeuristic lair full of monitors that keeps an eye on every dark corner of not just her domain, but all of Netherworld!
👁👁👁

So, of course it was only a matter of time before an anomaly such as Newbie caught her attention. And the more she watched, the more her curiosity evolved into a total obsession. So when the time to face her finally arrives, don’t expect any mercy because Sally loves, ahem, [b]hard[/b]😘

You have two options if you choose to go up against her: Either surrender willingly and spend the rest of eternity with her…or, she’ll [i]make[/i] you stay. 

Okay so that’s technically one choice, but if you’re as good as I expected, kiddo, maybe you have half a chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/b47d62a97408d2746d16df399668a68aed5be6be.gif[/img]
[i]If you bark for her, she’ll make the pain go away![/i]
 
We’ve gotta save some sexy secrets for later though, so our little tour through the Circle of Lust comes to an end here. Next time, let's meet at the entrance of the Circle of Gluttony! Get your best dress on, kid, it’s going to be the feast of a lifetime!

Until then, don’t forget to follow us on Twitter and join the Discord server to stay up to date on all the latest news and other degenerate antics!

Thanks for sticking around, everyone!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e2e6e75aa0a432d00602cec670afd9f5966135ea.gif[/img]

Hey deadbeats!

In this new series we want to give you a sneak peek at the Circles of Hell that await you and Newbie in your escape from the Netherworld. Don’t expect us to go into details just yet, but we hope our guided tour will give you a nice little taste of what’s to come.

With that out of the way, let’s dive straight into:

[h3]THE LIMBO[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e5ccb6ef8a44a73f3e9c1d96a7703d23fc8b8d57.png[/img]
[i]Get in line, buddy, we’ll be here for a while[/i]

Welcome to every sinner’s first stop in the afterlife. Unlike other circles of Hell, this one (supposedly) isn’t used for torture and instead is kind of a sorting facility for newcomers. But don’t let the lack of screams of terror and pain mislead you, because you are in Hell after all.

What you’re about to hear instead are the sighs of boredom and annoyance. The sounds of testing your patience. Take a look around. Everywhere you look are lines upon lines of souls of sinners waiting to be sorted and get out of this place…and nothing else.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/2cb7bc0653089d0a5db58512972796adcda25078.png[/img]
[i]A wild never before shown Limbo concept art appears![/i]


It’s not like you can’t stay here forever, in fact a lot of small-scale sinners do. Trust us, the bureaucratic machine of Hell doesn’t care as much about shoplifters as, say, genocidal maniacs. But this means you’ll have to spend the rest of the eternity [i]here[/i].

Beyond the Limbo there may be pain and suffering, but at least it’s not going to bore you to death. So get ready and queue up with the other lost souls. We'll see you on the other side of Limbo.

Now, let's make things a little more [i]interesting[/i]. If you want to shake things up a little here, you’ll have to meet [i]her[/i]…


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/e16b753a06b1e077a9630eaf7df2f812f5bc488e.png[/img]
[h3]CHUNKY[/h3]

It is not known for certain who, or what, Chunky really is. Is it a multitude of lost souls who have globbed together, gained some self-awareness, and found a job? Or is it the crown that controls this huge bubble?

Regardless, she’s the big boss of Limbo. However she prefers [i]The General Manager[/i], but really it’s the same thing here. You might think her job here isn’t really that important, and you’d be correct!

But don’t you underestimate her — despite being the weakest of the Circle Leaders, she’s more than capable of dealing with anyone foolish enough to cause disturbances in Limbo. Our tip — she’s the most dangerous when she’s in her karaoke mood 🎤. So uh, you might consider making yourself scarce when the speakers come out

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41646241/016be976448dc57470cdd2564563ebadf15cac05.gif[/img]
[i]It’s not the laser that hurts. It’s her high notes.[/i]


Trekking all the way through Limbo took longer than we thought, so this is where we’ll stop for today. Stay tuned for more Fleapit Lore coming soon (and even sooner for our backers on Indiegogo 👀). Don’t forget to follow us on Twitter and join the Discord server to stay up to date on news and other degenerate antics!
